seoTitle: Atlanta Public Schools Calendar 2026–27: Key Dates and Downloads
seoDescription: See key Atlanta Public Schools 2026–27 dates, view the official PDF, and add school breaks, early-release days, and other dates to your calendar.
heroSummary: Atlanta Public Schools starts the 2026–27 school year on Monday, August 3, 2026, and ends it on Thursday, May 27, 2027. Fall Break runs October 14–16, Thanksgiving Break runs November 23–27, and Spring Break runs April 5–9. APS also has two districtwide PreK–12 early-release days, on September 21 and March 15. After December Break, students return on Tuesday, January 5; January 4 is a teacher professional learning day.
calendarNotes: The official APS 2026–27 student calendar lists 180 instructional days: 88 in the first semester and 92 in the second. Early-release days are scheduled for September 21 and March 15. Teacher professional learning days are October 12–13, November 3, January 4, and February 15; students do not attend on those dates.

calendarFaqs.q: When are the APS early-release days in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: APS has two PreK–12 early-release days in 2026–27: Monday, September 21, 2026, and Monday, March 15, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: What is the difference between December Break and Winter Break?
calendarFaqs.a: APS calls the late-December holiday period December Break and the February closure Winter Break. December Break runs December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027; Winter Break runs February 16–19, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: Do students attend on teacher professional learning days?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Students are off on October 12–13, November 3, January 4, and February 15. These dates are teacher professional learning days rather than named school breaks.

calendarFaqs.q: Will the downloaded calendar update automatically if APS changes a date?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The calendar file is a one-time import and will not update automatically if APS revises its calendar. Check the official APS calendar page for later changes.
